skill.summary: Guide business owners through tax optimization by evaluating entity structure, maximizing deductions, planning compensation, and scheduling key tax deadlines.

latestVersion.changelog:
Tax Planning & Strategy — AI Agent Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release providing a structured framework for optimizing business tax strategy.
- Features entity structure analysis, deduction maximization checklist, and quarterly tax calendars for US/UK.
- Guides users on tax-efficient compensation, year-end tax moves, and international tax considerations.
- Identifies common mistakes and offers a prioritized action list with estimated dollar savings.
- Includes links to industry-specific tax guides and related AI tools for enhanced business support.
